intro: Rok Orhan knows the enemy well, but is a warrior and cannot say what the Gordunni orb is capable of. Rok knows of a mage in Orgrimmar who can tell more. The orb is yours to carry to Uthel'nay, at Orgrimmar's Darkbriar Lodge. This follows Dark Ceremony.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Although I know my enemy well, I am a warrior, friend. I cannot begin to tell you what this orb is capable of.
I know of a mage in Orgrimmar that will be able to tell us more about the orb. Take it to him.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What have you brought me, traveler?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This orb is very powerful, but also very dangerous.
